records.prompt_zh: 人物向右行走，相机在侧面以相同速度平行跟随；保持人物大小和画面位置稳定，背景向左移动，不环绕、不变焦。

records.example_prompt_en: A wide, eye-level, side-on full-body tracking shot of one adult engineer in dark blue workwear walking to the right along a large factory corridor. His entire head, torso, hands and both feet remain visible throughout, with generous space above the head and below the shoes. The camera is about six meters away from him at chest height and trucks right at exactly his walking speed. Keep his complete figure at the center at a constant scale. Photorealistic cinematography, no text or logos.
records.description_zh: 相机与移动主体平行同行，背景运动而主体相对稳定。
records.description_en: The camera travels alongside a moving subject, stabilizing its scale while the background passes.

records.use_cases_en: Walking scenes, conversations on the move and arrival at a workplace; maintain narrative continuity.

generation.review_notes_zh: 全身人物及头脚始终可见，人物向右行走、相机平行同行，背景窗户立柱向左掠过，人物尺寸与相对位置基本稳定。

records.prompt_zh: 相机本体平稳垂直上升，保持焦距不变；从平视逐渐变为轻俯视，展示原先被遮挡的环境，不以单纯仰摇代替升高。
records.prompt_en: Raise the entire camera smoothly upward at constant focal length. Progress from eye level to a slightly elevated view, revealing previously hidden surroundings. This is a physical rise, not a tilt up.
records.example_prompt_zh: 一位穿米色外套的成年人站在欧洲石砌庭院里。镜头从距离人物八米、眼睛高度的全身正面画面开始，完整展示头部与双脚。相机本体垂直升高约四米，轻微向下俯视以始终把整个人物保持在画面中央；不向上仰摇，不让人物出画。人物保持静止，相机越过人物后方矮石墙的高度，逐渐揭示墙后的花园小径。焦距固定，地平线稳定，无环绕、横移、滚转或剪辑，写实电影摄影，无文字。
records.example_prompt_en: A wide eye-level full-body frontal view of a still adult in a beige coat standing eight meters away in a European stone courtyard. Keep their complete head and feet inside the frame with generous margins. Physically raise the camera vertically by four meters while tilting gently DOWN to keep the entire person at the CENTER of the frame. The person does not move and never leaves the frame. Rising above a low stone wall behind them reveals the garden paths beyond it. Fixed focal length and stable horizon. The camera does NOT tilt upward, bank, roll, orbit or move sideways. One continuous photorealistic cinematic shot without cuts or text.
records.description_zh: 高度变化带来可见的遮挡关系改变；上升过程中可轻微调整朝向保持主体。
records.description_en: Changing camera height reveals surfaces and regions hidden below the initial sight line.
records.use_cases_zh: 空间揭示、场景建立、人物与环境关系；由个人扩展到整体。
records.use_cases_en: Spatial reveals, establishing shots and showing a person within a larger environment.

generation.review_notes_zh: 全身人物始终保留，镜头从平视升高后越过矮墙看到墙后的花园路径；人物不行走，升高与轻俯视的结合清晰。

records.prompt_en: Lower the entire camera smoothly from an elevated position to the subject’s height at a fixed focal length. Reframe gently to retain the subject; do not substitute a tilt or optical zoom.
records.example_prompt_zh: 木质工作台上放着一台复古银色相机，背景是温暖的工艺工作室。相机从桌面上方较高的位置下降到桌沿附近，最后以低机位三分之四侧面展示产品。 相机本体从高处平稳垂直下降到主体高度，焦距固定；视线随下降重新对准主体，不把运动做成单纯俯摇或变焦。 写实电影摄影，自然光影，空间结构稳定，无字幕、水印或标志。连续镜头，不切换场景。
records.example_prompt_en: A vintage silver camera rests on a wooden workbench in a warm artisan studio. Begin well above the tabletop and physically descend toward the table edge. Finish with a low three-quarter product view, revealing its front face as the viewpoint lowers. The product stays still. Lower the entire camera smoothly from an elevated position to the subject’s height at a fixed focal length. Reframe gently to retain the subject; do not substitute a tilt or optical zoom. records.use_cases_en: Introduce a product or character; bring attention from the environment down to a specific subject.

records.example_prompt_zh: 傍晚的咖啡馆内，一位穿灰色毛衣的成年女子坐在窗边沉思，前景桌边有一只白色咖啡杯。相机从中景缓慢靠近她，最后停在脸部近景，前景杯子逐渐滑出边缘。她保持安静，只轻轻呼吸。 相机沿光轴缓慢向前接近主体，焦距固定；主体逐渐变大，前后景透视关系自然改变，不能只是裁切放大。 写实电影摄影，自然光影，空间结构稳定，无字幕、水印或标志。连续镜头，不切换场景。
records.example_prompt_en: At dusk in a quiet cafe, an adult woman in a gray sweater sits thoughtfully beside a window. A white cup occupies the near edge of the table. She remains almost still, breathing gently. Slowly dolly the camera forward along the optical axis toward the subject with a fixed focal length. The subject grows and foreground/background perspective changes naturally; do not simulate this with a crop or zoom. records.use_cases_zh: 推近人物内心、酝酿情绪、发现物体细节、突出主体。
records.use_cases_en: Approach a character’s inner state, build emotion, reveal an object’s details and emphasize a subject.

records.example_prompt_en: At dawn in an old railway station, an adult traveler in a brown coat sits on a wooden bench. Start close to his face and move backward, revealing the bench, a suitcase on the floor, and the high-ceilinged station hall. End with the traveler small within the larger space. He remains seated. Dolly backward smoothly along the optical axis at fixed focal length. Expand from a close view of the subject to reveal foreground and surroundings with genuine perspective change. records.description_zh: 通过相机后退逐步加入环境信息；不是只改变焦距。

records.use_cases_en: Establish context, reveal a character’s circumstances, express isolation and broaden narrative scale.

records.example_prompt_en: An adult man in a dark green jacket stands still in a spacious studio with red brick columns and large windows. Start facing him from the front and move the camera along a ninety-degree arc toward his right profile. He does not turn. Windows and brick columns shift behind him with clear continuous parallax. Orbit the camera smoothly through approximately ninety degrees around a stationary subject. Keep distance and focal length stable. The subject must not spin; the background angle and occlusion change continuously. Photorealistic cinematography, natural lighting, stable spatial geometry, no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos. records.description_en: The camera changes its viewing angle around a fixed subject rather than making the subject rotate.

records.use_cases_en: Character presentation, showing product volume, changing relationships and creating emotional enclosure.

records.prompt_en: Keep the camera position and orientation completely fixed and slowly increase the optical focal length. Enlarge the subject without changing perspective or occlusion. No forward camera travel.
records.example_prompt_zh: 一名穿灰色毛衣的成年女子坐在窗边，身后有规则的书架和竖直窗框，前景桌上有一只杯子。相机固定在三脚架上，从中景缓慢光学变焦到脸部近景，所有物体只围绕画面中心同比放大。 相机位置与朝向完全固定，只缓慢增加镜头焦距；主体放大但透视与遮挡关系不变，不推进相机。 写实电影摄影，自然光影，空间结构稳定，无字幕、水印或标志。连续镜头，不切换场景。
records.example_prompt_en: An adult woman in a gray sweater sits beside a window, with a regular bookshelf and vertical window frames behind her and a cup on the near table. The camera is locked on a tripod. Perform a slow optical zoom from a medium view to a close view of her face. Objects scale about the frame center; their relative perspective and overlap remain unchanged. Keep the camera position and orientation completely fixed and slowly increase the optical focal length. Enlarge the subject without changing perspective or occlusion. No forward camera travel. Photorealistic cinematography, natural lighting, stable spatial geometry, no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos. One continuous shot, no cuts.
records.description_zh: 焦距改变导致视角变窄；机位不动，画面没有移机造成的新视差。

records.use_cases_en: Emphasize a distant subject, suggest surveillance and compare zooming against a physical dolly in.

generation.review_notes_zh: 由中景连续变为面部近景，窗框书架与人物同比放大，未出现横向移机或切镜，展示固定机位变焦观感。

records.prompt_en: Begin with a parallel side tracking shot of a walking person. After the person places an object down, stop following them, transfer attention to the stationary object and dolly toward it while shifting focus from person to object. Finish with a stable close view.

records.example_prompt_en: In a glass-walled workshop office inside a German automotive factory, an assembly line is visible outside and a desk stands in the center. During seconds 0–3, an adult man carries silver keys and walks right as the camera tracks parallel in a side-on full shot. At seconds 3–4 he gently places the keys on the desk near the lens and keeps walking right. During seconds 4–8 the camera leaves him, slowly approaches the stationary keys and shifts focus onto them. End with a clear side close-up of the complete key ring on the desktop. Begin with a parallel side tracking shot of a walking person. records.prompt_zh: 相机沿光轴后退的同时逐渐拉长焦距，保持主体在画面中的大小基本不变；背景透视明显压缩，主体位置与姿态稳定。
records.prompt_en: Dolly backward while simultaneously zooming in to keep the subject nearly constant in frame size. The background perspective visibly compresses while subject position and pose remain steady.
records.example_prompt_zh: 经典希区柯克滑动变焦。深色西装成年男子静止站在有重复门框和顶灯的长走廊中央，以腰部以上中景开始，人物头部和躯干在开始与结束时都恰好占画面高度的一半，画面大小保持不变。相机本体沿光轴后退，镜头同时从广角向长焦变焦，抵消人物尺寸变化；走廊背景明显压缩，远处的门仿佛靠近人物背后。人物不走动、不变大，地平线稳定，八秒连续写实电影镜头，不切镜、不显示文字。
records.example_prompt_en: A classic VERTIGO DOLLY ZOOM, also called a Hitchcock zoom. A motionless adult man in a dark suit is centered in a long corridor with repeating doorways and ceiling lights. Begin in a medium waist-up view. His head and torso occupy exactly the SAME half of the image height at the beginning and at the end. The camera physically dollies BACKWARD while the lens simultaneously ZOOMS IN from a wide angle to telephoto, cancelling all change of the man's screen size. The background corridor dramatically compresses and its far door appears to move closer behind him. The man stands perfectly still, never walks and does not change size. Stable horizon, one continuous eight-second photorealistic cinematic shot. No ordinary push-in, no subject enlargement, no cuts, no text.
records.description_zh: 移机与反向变焦共同保持主体尺寸并改变背景透视。
records.description_en: Dolly travel and opposite zoom retain subject size while changing background perspective.

records.example_prompt_zh: 两个镜头，在第三秒明确硬切。第一镜0至3秒：一名沉思的成年工程师坐在工厂办公室里，正面中近景，面部清晰位于中央。相机缓慢向前推近，从腰部以上画面到面部近景，脸逐渐变大，不横摇。第三秒突然硬切，不叠化、不变形。第二镜3至8秒：切到白天工厂入口外部全景，相机本体向上升起，揭示屋顶与相邻建筑，地平线保持水平。室内亲密推近与室外升高揭示必须清楚区分，写实电影摄影，不出现文字。
records.example_prompt_en: TWO SHOTS with an explicit HARD CUT at three seconds. SHOT ONE, seconds 0–3: a close-medium frontal portrait of ONE thoughtful adult engineer seated inside a factory office, his face clearly visible in the center. Slowly DOLLY FORWARD toward his face, from waist-up to close-up; his face gets larger. No panning. At exactly three seconds make an abrupt HARD CUT, not a dissolve and not a morph.
